issues.title: School tax cap question on the November 3 ballot
issues.summary: Conway voters will decide whether to limit the Conway School District's local property tax for two years under RSA 32:5-i. The levy could grow only by inflation plus new construction, and SAU central office spending could not exceed 6 percent of district spending; bonded building costs are excluded. SAU 9 says central office spending is now 4.37 percent. The Municipal Budget Committee voted 0 in favor, 9 against, with 3 abstaining. A state law (HB 1300) requires three fifths of voters to approve a cap. Only three residents who do not regularly attend school meetings came to the board's information session.

methodology: Built October 31, 2026 from SAU 9 and SAU 13 web pages, Jackson Grammar and Madison Elementary sites, the Conway 2025 and 2026 school sample ballots, Bartlett Selectmen minutes, NHPR, Ballotpedia and Conway Daily Sun articles. Conway's schools changed since 2024: John H. Fuller Elementary closed, Pine Tree became the K-2 school and the former Conway Elementary building is now Conway Intermediate (grades 3-5). Cost per pupil is the NH Department of Education 2023-24 report; the copy opened is posted by the Rye Civic League because the state-hosted 2023-24 file was not found (the state-hosted 2022-23 report lists Conway $22,086, Bartlett $27,602, Jackson $35,688, Madison $31,696). Enrollment figures are rounded numbers the Conway Daily Sun reported in June 2025 for 2024-25 (Pine Tree, then named Lakeside, about 209; Bartlett about 158; Kennett High about 614; Kennett Middle about 300), not state counts; the NH DOE profile site returned errors. Gaps: no official test score or graduation results were found, so results are empty; 2026-27 budgets for Bartlett, Jackson and Madison were not found (Madison's are in SAU 13 Google Drive files that could not be opened); Jackson board members other than the chair, the Conway vice chair after the roster change, the Madison principal and the Career and Technical Center's details were not found; Bartlett officer roles date from April 2025. Conway, Bartlett and Jackson meeting dates after November come from each board's regular schedule and should be checked against the SAU 9 calendar. The Bartlett and Jackson news headlines are taken from the article web addresses because the page text did not show a headline or date; the Bartlett tuition vote date (March 3, 2026) is inferred from the article's reference to Jackson voting that Thursday, March 5.
